vessels.name: EL FARO
vessels.label: Historical loss: sailed towards Joaquin
vessels.note: Commercial cargo reference, not a yacht. NOAA coastal AIS plus NTSB recorded offshore positions; 29 September–1 October 2015.

historicalCase.title: El Faro / Hurricane Joaquin — historical loss case
historicalCase.finding: The NTSB identified insufficient action to avoid Joaquin, failure to use current weather information and ineffective bridge teamwork. The vessel was lost on 1 October 2015. These are post-event findings, not a prediction made before the loss.
historicalCase.trackingNote: NOAA coastal AIS ends before the final encounter. Recorded VDR positions from NTSB attachment 12 supply the offshore track. Explicit EDT labels were converted to UTC and checked against 32 independent WAM UTC records. VDR speed and course are not supplied; direction uses recorded position displacement.
